Reco LLC

Connecting discovery, saved places and recommendations.

Reco’s consumer-app design material covers finding, saving and sharing places through connected search, profile and recommendation flows.

ProjectReco
Contribution / source record2021 source cover credits Sindy; exact responsibility to confirm.

Design approach

  • Map and list views provide complementary ways to browse nearby results.
  • Filters narrow choices by practical visit criteria such as availability and suitability.
  • Profiles, visited places, wishlists and recommendation creation connect discovery to ongoing use.

Why this work matters

The breadth of connected flows makes this a promising consumer-product story about organizing discovery around real visit decisions.
